name: openlmis-form-fields
title: Form Fields
description: TanStack Form field components on shadcn Field: text, password with a show button, a type-to-filter combobox, radio and switch choice cards, required marks, inline errors, and skeletons that hold the form's shape while values load.
docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.
